description: This PHP class 'PendingAction' resides in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Dashboard\Dto\ActionSummary' and is responsible for representing a pending action summary in the OrangeHRM dashboard module. It encapsulates an 'ActionSummary' object and provides a method to generate a summary array if there are pending actions.

classes.name: PendingAction
classes.description: Represents a pending action summary with methods to generate a summary array if actions are pending.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PendingAction object with an ActionSummary instance.

methods.name: generateActionSummary
methods.description: Returns an array containing group details and pending action count if there are pending actions; otherwise returns null.
